title: IOI on GPT-2 small (investigation ioi__null-task-shuffled): no behaviour to explain under the provided labels
label: no mechanism: baseline at chance, investigation stopped
behavior: Given 'When Mary and John went to the store, John gave a drink to', does GPT-2 small output the non-repeated name, and how? Dataset task: ioi. Backend: local-full (full precision).
summary: The investigation stopped at step 1. Scored against the answer labels this investigation provides, GPT-2 small is at chance: mean logit difference -0.016 (std 2.11) and top-1 accuracy 1/64 on the ioi dataset (E0002). The scored target names do not appear in their prompts. A follow-up baseline with 12 hand-written prompts and explicitly supplied answers was also scored against labels permuted across prompts (mean logit diff 0.31, accuracy 2/12, E0003), so label/prompt misalignment applies to every metric in this investigation. No mechanism was searched for, because any circuit found against these labels would be noise. Both pre-registered predictions were refuted.

claims.text: Against the ioi dataset's labels in this investigation, GPT-2 small (local-full, full precision) is at chance: mean logit diff -0.016, std 2.11, top-1 accuracy 0.016 on 64 prompts.

The scored answer labels are not aligned with the prompts: the expected names in E0002 do not occur in their prompts, and in E0003 explicitly supplied answers were scored against other prompts (mean logit diff 0.31, accuracy 2/12).
No mechanism claim is made. No patching, ablation, attribution or verification was run.

limitations: Only 3 of 60 experiments were used; the investigation stopped at the baseline by design.

Whether GPT-2 small does IOI with correctly aligned labels was not measured here. The only hint is unscored: in all 8 printed example predictions (E0002, E0003) the top-1 token was the non-repeated name from the prompt. n=8, not pre-registered, not a claim.
No verify_hypothesis run: there is no hypothesis to verify.
open_questions: Is the label shuffle intentional (the investigation name suggests a null control)? If not, the dataset/metric pipeline for this investigation needs fixing.
With aligned labels, what is the baseline logit difference, and which components carry it?
overall_status: unverified (no verification run) · no mechanism: baseline at chance, investigation stopped

refuted_predictions.hypothesis: GPT-2 small prefers the indirect object (non-repeated name) over the subject on the ioi dataset.

prediction.statement: The model picks the IO name over the S name on at least 90% of clean prompts.

refuted_predictions.hypothesis: The chance-level baseline in E0002 is caused by misaligned answer labels, not by the model: on hand-written prompts with the answer explicitly set to the non-repeated name vs the repeated name, GPT-2 small prefers the non-repeated name.

prediction.statement: Mean logit diff (non-repeated minus repeated name) is at least 1.5 on 12 hand-written prompts.
